# Zachary Spencer

> Zachary Spencer is the founder of Zenith Co. (Zenith Co Marketing, LLC), an agency that runs paid ads for established Florida tree service companies, and an accountancy student at the University of South Florida. He is based in Tampa, Florida. This is his personal site: who he is, what he has built, and what he has learned building websites and running ads for tree companies.

The writing here is aimed at tree service company owners and at anyone looking up Zachary Spencer. Every article is written by Zachary Spencer. Client details come from the public case pages on zenithcomarketing.com. No lead, revenue or pricing figures for any client are published on this site.

## About

- [Zachary Spencer](https://zacharyspencer.dev/): Who Zachary Spencer is in 200 words: founder of Zenith Co., accountancy student at the University of South Florida, based in Tampa, and what he does for Florida tree service companies.
- [About Zachary Spencer](https://zacharyspencer.dev/about/): The longer version: how he went from building websites for three Florida tree companies to an ads service billed per shown estimate, what he studies, what else he has built, and how to contact him.

## Writing

- [Why I bill tree companies per shown estimate](https://zacharyspencer.dev/writing/why-i-bill-per-shown-estimate/): What a retainer, a shared lead site and a per-estimate fee each get paid for, what counts as a shown estimate and what does not bill, who pays the ad spend, and which companies the model is a poor fit for.
- [What a tree company open since 1988 needed from its first website](https://zacharyspencer.dev/writing/first-website-for-a-1988-tree-company/): What Zachary Spencer built for Andy's PGM in Sarasota and why: a page per service, only the company's own photos, a photo estimate form, the phone number first, and what a website cannot do for a tree company.
- [Why I put a photo estimate form on tree service websites](https://zacharyspencer.dev/writing/photo-estimate-forms/): What a photo estimate form is, why it suits owner-operated tree companies such as King's Tree Service in Palm Bay, what it should ask for, and why it does not replace walking the job.
- [All writing](https://zacharyspencer.dev/writing/): The index of everything Zachary Spencer has written here.

## Zenith Co.

- [Zenith Co.](https://zenithcomarketing.com): The agency Zachary Spencer founded. Paid ads for established Florida tree service companies, billed per shown estimate, one company per service area.
- [Zenith Co. pricing](https://zenithcomarketing.com/pricing/): The full terms of the per-estimate ads service.
- [Zenith Co. work](https://zenithcomarketing.com/work/): The three client builds: A Tree Surgeons Enterprise (Tampa), King's Tree Service (Palm Bay) and Andy's PGM (Sarasota).
